scene.summary: Rohan is settled after sustained circulation was restored in the resuscitation bay. The bay is quiet enough to plan, not quiet enough to assume the work is finished.

dialogue.speaker: Bedside nurse
dialogue.line: Circulation is holding. AAC is powered. We still treat every new alarm as a question.

captions: Monitor soft. Ventilator circuit verified. Communication device visible at the bedside.

clinicalTruth.airway: Current acute ET route remains dependable; replacement is not indicated.
clinicalTruth.breathing: Chest movement matches full controlled ventilation on a verified primary circuit.
clinicalTruth.circulation: Pulse is fragile with frequent ectopy; defibrillator readiness is unset.
clinicalTruth.communicationAccess: Device powered and visible; WAIT is active; no clinical question is open.

visibleEvidence.label: Quiet post-ROSC window
visibleEvidence.detail: Sustained circulation was already restored before ICU play began.

visibleEvidence.label: AAC visible
visibleEvidence.detail: Communication device is powered and in reach; silence is not consent.

visibleEvidence.label: Portable suction battery arrived
visibleEvidence.detail: Degraded endurance unit is present. Assignment is not yet decided.

hiddenState.primaryCause: Not yet established. External circuit load remains a candidate, not a verdict.
notes: Do not reveal a single cause during quiet stabilisation.

communicationBeat.note: Respect WAIT. Do not ask non-emergency questions while the instruction stands.

familyBeat.note: Family remain present for comfort and continuity, never as clinical workforce.

exitConditions.description: An intermittent monitor alarm opens the next clinical question.
